shortDescription: Manages a Batch Account Pool on Azure

options.name: ad_user
options.description: Active Directory username. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: adfs_authority_url
options.description: Azure AD authority url. Use when authenticating with Username/password, and has your own ADFS authority.

options.name: api_profile
options.description: Selects an API profile to use when communicating with Azure services. Default value of C(latest) is appropriate for public clouds; future values will allow use with Azure Stack.

options.name: application_licenses
options.description: The list of application licenses must be a subset of available Batch service application licenses. If a license is requested which is not supported, pool creation will fail.

options.name: application_packages
options.description: Changes to application package references affect all new compute nodes joining the pool. But do not affect compute nodes that are already in the pool until they are rebooted or reimaged. There is a maximum of 10 application package references on any given pool.

options.name: auth_source
options.description: Controls the source of the credentials to use for authentication. Can also be set via the C(ANSIBLE_AZURE_AUTH_SOURCE) environment variable. When set to C(auto) (the default) the precedence is module parameters -> C(env) -> C(credential_file) -> C(cli). When set to C(env), the credentials will be read from the environment variables. When set to C(credential_file), it will read the profile from C(~/.azure/credentials). When set to C(cli), the credentials will be sources from the Azure CLI profile

options.name: batch_account_name
options.description: The name of the Batch Account.

options.name: cert_validation_mode
options.description: Controls the certificate validation behavior for Azure endpoints. By default, all modules will validate the server certificate, but when an HTTPS proxy is in use, or against Azure Stack, it may be necessary to disable this behavior by passing C(ignore). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CERT_VALIDATION) environment variable.

options.name: certificates
options.description: For Windows compute nodes, the Batch service installs the certificates to the specified certificate store and location. For Linux compute nodes, the certificates are stored in a directory inside the task working directory and an environment variable AZ_BATCH_CERTIFICATES_DIR is supplied to the task to query for this location. For certificates with visibility of 'remoteUser', a 'certs' directory is created in the user's home directory and certificates are placed in that directory.

options.name: client_id
options.description: Azure client ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal or Managed Identity (msi). Can also be set via the C(AZURE_CLIENT_ID) environment variable.

options.name: cloud_environment
options.description: For cloud environments other than the US public cloud, the environment name (as defined by Azure Python SDK, eg, C(AzureChinaCloud), C(AzureUSGovernment)), or a metadata discovery endpoint URL (required for Azure Stack). Can also be set via credential file profile or the C(AZURE_CLOUD_ENVIRONMENT) environment variable.

options.name: deployment_configuration
options.description: Using CloudServiceConfiguration specifies that the nodes should be creating using Azure Cloud Services (PaaS). Using VirtualMachineConfiguration uses Azure Virtual Machines (IaaS).

options.name: disable_instance_discovery
options.description: Determines whether or not instance discovery is performed when attempting to authenticate. Setting this to true will completely disable both instance discovery and authority validation. This functionality is intended for use in scenarios where the metadata endpoint cannot be reached such as in private clouds or Azure Stack. options.name: display_name
options.description: The display name for the pool.

options.name: identity
options.description: The type of identity used for the Batch Pool. If the pool identity is updated during update an existing pool. Only the new vms which are created after the pool shrinks to 0 will have the updated identities.

options.name: inter_node_communication
options.description: This imposes restrictions on which nodes can be assigned to the pool. Enabling this value can reduce the chance of the requested number of nodes to be allocated in the pool. If not specified, this value defaults to C(Disabled).

options.name: is_disable_auto_scale
options.description: Whether disables automatic scaling for a pool.

options.name: is_stop_resize
options.description: Whether stops an ongoing resize operation on the pool.

options.name: log_mode
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: log_path
options.description: Parent argument.

options.name: metadata
options.description: The Batch service does not assign any meaning to this metadata; it is solely for the use of user code.

options.name: mount_configuration
options.description: This supports Azure Files, NFS, CIFS/SMB, and Blobfuse.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the Batch Account Pool.

options.name: network_configuration
options.description: The network configuration for a pool.

options.name: oidc_token
options.description: Direct OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. This token is exchanged with Azure AD using OIDC federated identity. Useful in CI systems (for example GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps) where an OIDC token is provided directly by the platform. Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: oidc_token_file_path
options.description: Path to a file containing an OpenID Connect (OIDC) token (JWT) used for workload identity authentication. The file must contain only raw token. This method is commonly used in platforms that materialize OIDC tokens as files Can also be set via the C(AZURE_FEDERATED_TOKEN_FILE) environment variable.

options.name: password
options.description: Active Directory user password. Use when authenticating with an Active Directory user rather than service principal.

options.name: profile
options.description: Security profile found in ~/.azure/credentials file.

options.name: resource_group
options.description: The name of the resource group in which to create the Batch Account Pool.

options.name: resource_tags
options.description: The user-defined tags to be associated with the Azure Batch Pool. When specified, these tags are propagated to the backing Azure resources associated with the pool. This property can only be specified when the Batch account was created with the poolAllocationMode property set to 'UserSubscription'.

options.name: scale_settings
options.description: Defines the desired size of the pool. This can either be 'fixedScale' where the requested targetDedicatedNodes is specified, or 'autoScale' which defines a formula which is periodically reevaluated. If this property is not specified, the pool will have a fixed scale with 0 targetDedicatedNodes.

options.name: secret
options.description: Azure client secret. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: start_task
options.description: In an PATCH (update) operation, this property can be set to an empty object to remove the start task from the pool.

options.name: state
options.description: Assert the state of the Batch Account Pool. Use C(present) to create or update a Batch Account Pool and C(absent) to delete it.

options.name: subscription_id
options.description: Your Azure subscription Id.

options.name: target_node_communication_mode
options.description: If omitted, the default value is C(Default).

options.name: task_scheduling_policy
options.description: Specifies how tasks should be distributed across compute nodes.

options.name: task_slots_per_node
options.description: The default value is C(1). The maximum value is the smaller of 4 times the number of cores of the vmSize of the pool or 256.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Azure tenant ID. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.

options.name: thumbprint
options.description: The thumbprint of the private key specified in I(x509_certificate_path). Use when authenticating with a Service Principal. Required if I(x509_certificate_path) is defined.

options.name: upgrade_policy
options.description: Describes an upgrade policy.

options.name: user_accounts
options.description: The list of user accounts to be created on each node in the pool.

options.name: vm_size
options.description: For information about available sizes of virtual machines for Cloud Services Pools. Batch supports all Cloud Services VM sizes except ExtraSmall, A1V2 and A2V2, Batch supports all Azure VM sizes except STANDARD_A0 and those with premium storage (STANDARD_GS, STANDARD_DS, and STANDARD_DSV2 series).

options.name: x509_certificate_path
options.description: Path to the X509 certificate used to create the service principal in PEM format. The certificate must be appended to the private key. Use when authenticating with a Service Principal.
